note: Real dishes for the Idea agent. Code picks 12 per request (craving matches first, the rest at random, none with an excluded food): smartbite_engine/inspiration.py. core = main foods by their English key (data/open/aliases.json), pantry items left out; Spanish names resolve through the aliases. Researched from public recipe sites (source = the page); methods are short summaries in our own words.

dishes.name: Chicken thigh, potato and olive traybake
dishes.method: Roast thighs with potatoes, olives, lemon and whole garlic in one tin until the skin is crisp.

dishes.name: Greek chicken bowls
dishes.method: Marinate and cook the chicken, then pack it over rice with chopped cucumber, tomato and feta, with a yogurt sauce on the side.

dishes.name: Mexican chicken rice bowl
dishes.method: Cook spiced chicken, warm it with corn, and serve over rice with avocado and fresh tomato.

dishes.name: Cobb salad with yogurt dressing
dishes.method: Arrange sliced cooked chicken, boiled egg, avocado and tomato over chopped lettuce; swap the oil dressing for yogurt and mustard.

dishes.name: Moroccan chicken with couscous and chickpeas
dishes.method: Simmer spiced chicken with carrot, onion and chickpeas, then serve over couscous steeped in hot water.

dishes.name: Avgolemono (Greek lemon chicken soup)
dishes.method: Poach chicken in broth with rice, then thicken the soup with an egg and lemon mixture tempered with hot broth.

dishes.name: Healthy chicken tikka masala with chickpeas and spinach
dishes.method: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices, then simmer it in a spiced tomato sauce with chickpeas and wilted spinach.

dishes.name: Chicken shawarma quinoa bowls
dishes.method: Roast shawarma-spiced chicken and serve over quinoa with cucumber, tomato and a spoon of hummus.

dishes.name: Oyakodon (chicken and egg rice bowl)
dishes.method: Simmer chicken and spring onion in a soy-based stock, set beaten egg over the top, and slide it onto rice.

dishes.name: Thai basil chicken (pad krapow gai)
dishes.method: Stir-fry chicken with garlic, red pepper and green beans in a savory sauce and serve over rice.

dishes.name: Chicken cacciatore
dishes.method: Brown the chicken, then braise it with peppers, mushrooms and onion in a tomato sauce.

dishes.name: Pollo al chilindron
dishes.method: Brown the chicken and cook it slowly in a sauce of red and green pepper, tomato, onion and garlic.

dishes.name: Parmesan roasted cauliflower and chicken sheet pan
dishes.method: Roast chicken breasts and cauliflower florets on one tray, finishing with grated hard cheese and lemon.

dishes.name: Sheet pan chicken with Brussels sprouts and sweet potato
dishes.method: Roast chicken pieces, Brussels sprouts and sweet potato chunks together on one tray.

dishes.name: One-pot lemon artichoke chicken and rice
dishes.method: Brown chicken pieces, add garlic, artichokes, rice, stock and lemon, and simmer until the rice is cooked.

dishes.name: Teriyaki salmon rice bowl
dishes.method: Bake salmon glazed with teriyaki and serve over rice with cucumber and edamame.

dishes.name: Sheet pan teriyaki salmon with sweet potato and broccoli
dishes.method: Roast sweet potato cubes first, then add salmon and broccoli to the same tray and bake with teriyaki sauce.

dishes.name: Baked salmon quinoa bowl
dishes.method: Bake lemon-seasoned salmon and serve over quinoa with arugula and sliced cucumber.

dishes.name: Sheet pan salmon and green beans with lemon
dishes.method: Season salmon with lemon and herbs, surround it with green beans on a tray, and bake until the fish flakes.

dishes.name: Salmon fried rice
dishes.method: Cook and flake salmon, then stir-fry cold rice with scrambled egg, peas and spring onion and fold the fish back in.

dishes.name: Whole wheat pasta with salmon and spinach
dishes.method: Toss cooked pasta with flaked salmon, wilted spinach and cherry tomatoes in a light pan sauce.

dishes.name: Salmon poke bowl
dishes.method: Marinate diced salmon in soy and sesame, then pile it on rice with avocado, cucumber and edamame.

dishes.name: Greek yogurt tuna salad
dishes.method: Mix drained tuna with yogurt, mustard and lemon instead of mayonnaise and eat it with salad leaves.

dishes.name: Fresh tuna poke bowl
dishes.method: Marinate cubed tuna in soy, garlic and ginger and serve it over brown rice with edamame and avocado.

dishes.name: Ensalada de garbanzos y atun con vinagreta de mostaza
dishes.method: Toss cooked chickpeas, flaked tuna, tomatoes and spring onion over lettuce with a mustard dressing.

dishes.name: Ensalada de pasta con atun
dishes.method: Cool cooked pasta and mix it with tuna, corn and diced tomato.

dishes.name: Salade nicoise
dishes.method: Arrange tuna, boiled eggs, boiled potatoes, green beans, tomato and olives on a bed of leaves.

dishes.name: Aguacate relleno de atun
dishes.method: Mix tuna with diced red pepper and lime or lemon juice and spoon it into halved avocados.

dishes.name: Atun encebollado
dishes.method: Sear fresh tuna and serve it with onions and garlic slowly softened in a covered pan.

dishes.name: Tonno e fagioli (tuna and white bean salad)
dishes.method: Combine drained white beans with flaked tuna, thin onion, parsley and lemon juice.

dishes.name: Korean ground beef rice bowl
dishes.method: Brown ground beef with garlic in a sweet-savory soy sauce and serve it over rice with spring onion.

dishes.name: Ground beef and broccoli
dishes.method: Brown the beef, stir-fry broccoli, then combine both in a thickened soy and garlic sauce over rice.

dishes.name: Albondigas de ternera en salsa de tomate
dishes.method: Shape seasoned beef into balls, brown them, and finish cooking in a tomato and onion sauce.

dishes.name: Stuffed peppers with beef and rice
dishes.method: Fill pepper halves with browned beef, rice and tomato, then bake covered until the peppers are soft.

dishes.name: Beef kofta with yogurt sauce
dishes.method: Mix beef with onion, parsley and spices, shape into fingers, bake, and serve with garlic yogurt.

dishes.name: Healthy pasta bolognese
dishes.method: Simmer lean beef with mushrooms in tomato sauce and toss it with whole wheat pasta.

dishes.name: Beef stuffed zucchini boats
dishes.method: Scoop out zucchini halves, fill with a beef and tomato mixture, top with cheese and bake.

dishes.name: Turkey and vegetable stir-fry
dishes.method: Stir-fry diced turkey with broccoli, pepper, carrot and mushrooms in a light soy-ginger sauce.

dishes.name: Turkey taco skillet
dishes.method: Cook finely diced turkey with peppers, onion, corn and tomato in one skillet with taco spices.

dishes.name: Turkey scallopini with lemon
dishes.method: Pan-fry thin turkey cutlets and finish them in a quick garlic, lemon and stock sauce.

dishes.name: Greek turkey rice bowls
dishes.method: Cook oregano-seasoned turkey and serve over rice with cucumber, tomato, feta and a yogurt sauce.

dishes.name: Turkey and sweet potato skillet
dishes.method: Brown diced turkey with onion and pepper, add sweet potato cubes, cover and cook until tender.

dishes.name: Turkey lettuce wraps
dishes.method: Stir-fry finely diced turkey with garlic, ginger and spring onion in a savory sauce and spoon it into lettuce leaves.

dishes.name: Mexican turkey stuffed sweet potatoes
dishes.method: Bake sweet potatoes, then fill them with spiced turkey and corn and top with avocado.

dishes.name: Guiso de pavo con pimientos y champinones
dishes.method: Soften onion and peppers, add turkey strips and mushrooms, and cook everything together in a pan.

dishes.name: Sheet pan pork tenderloin with potatoes and carrots
dishes.method: Roast pork tenderloin on a tray with potatoes and carrots until the center is just cooked.

dishes.name: Lomo de cerdo con pimientos
dishes.method: Sear pork loin pieces and stew them in a sauce of tomato, onion, garlic and roasted pepper.

dishes.name: Pork loin stir-fry with broccoli and carrots
dishes.method: Stir-fry sliced pork loin with broccoli and carrot in a soy and ginger sauce and serve over rice.

dishes.name: Pork souvlaki with tzatziki
dishes.method: Marinate pork cubes with lemon, garlic and herbs, grill them on skewers, and serve with cucumber yogurt sauce.

dishes.name: Pork fried rice
dishes.method: Stir-fry diced pork, then cold rice with peas and scrambled egg, seasoned with soy or teriyaki sauce.

dishes.name: Pork loin and mustard skewers
dishes.method: Marinate pork cubes in mustard, lemon and garlic, thread them with onion, and grill.

dishes.name: Cottage cheese vegetable frittata
dishes.method: Cook the vegetables in a skillet, pour over eggs whisked with cottage cheese, and finish in the oven.

dishes.name: Shakshuka
dishes.method: Simmer onion, pepper and tomato with spices, then poach eggs in wells in the sauce and top with feta.

dishes.name: Tortilla de patatas
dishes.method: Slowly cook potato and onion in a pan, mix with beaten eggs, and set the tortilla on both sides.

dishes.name: Spanakopita egg muffins
dishes.method: Mix eggs with spinach, feta and spring onion, pour into a muffin tin, and bake.

dishes.name: Chinese tomato and egg stir-fry
dishes.method: Scramble eggs briefly, stir-fry ripe tomato until juicy, combine, and serve over rice.

dishes.name: Pisto manchego con huevos
dishes.method: Cook onion, pepper, zucchini and tomato slowly into a soft stew and serve with eggs set on top.

dishes.name: Zucchini frittata
dishes.method: Saute zucchini and spring onion, add eggs and grated cheese, and finish the frittata in the oven.

dishes.name: Revuelto de champinones
dishes.method: Saute mushrooms with garlic, then stir in beaten eggs until just set and finish with parsley.

dishes.name: Pea and ricotta frittata
dishes.method: Soften onion with peas, mix eggs with ricotta-style cheese and grated cheese, and bake in a dish.

dishes.name: Greek yogurt egg salad
dishes.method: Chop hard-boiled eggs and mix with yogurt and mustard instead of mayonnaise.

dishes.name: Menemen (Turkish eggs with tomato and pepper)
dishes.method: Cook onion, pepper and tomato down, then stir in beaten eggs until just set.

dishes.name: Tortilla de espinacas y judias blancas
dishes.method: Saute onion with spinach and white beans, mix with beaten eggs, and cook the tortilla slowly.

dishes.name: Huevos a la flamenca
dishes.method: Build a base of potato, peas, pepper and tomato in a dish, crack eggs on top, and bake until set.

dishes.name: Spinach egg drop soup
dishes.method: Simmer broth with tomato and garlic, add spinach, and swirl in beaten egg to form ribbons.

dishes.name: Lentejas viudas (lentils with vegetables)
dishes.method: Simmer lentils with finely chopped vegetables, then stir in a quick garlic and paprika sofrito.

dishes.name: Garbanzos con espinacas
dishes.method: Saute onion and garlic with paprika and cumin, add chickpeas and broth, then wilt in the spinach.

dishes.name: White bean and kale soup
dishes.method: Soften onion, carrot and garlic, add beans and stock, and cook the kale in at the end.

dishes.name: Mediterranean lentil soup
dishes.method: Simmer lentils with carrot, onion, garlic and herbs and finish with lemon juice.

dishes.name: Gigantes plaki (Greek baked beans)
dishes.method: Bake large white beans in a herby tomato and onion sauce until thick.

dishes.name: Chana masala
dishes.method: Cook onion, garlic and spices with tomato into a sauce and simmer the chickpeas in it.

dishes.name: Mujadara (lentils and rice with onions)
dishes.method: Caramelize onions, cook lentils and rice together with cumin, and serve with plain yogurt.

dishes.name: Pasta e fagioli
dishes.method: Build a vegetable base with tomato, add beans and stock, and cook small pasta in the pot.

dishes.name: Butternut squash and lentil stew
dishes.method: Simmer squash cubes and lentils with onion, garlic and tomato until both are tender.

dishes.name: Ensalada de tomate, lentejas y huevo
dishes.method: Mix cooled cooked lentils with diced tomato, spring onion and chopped boiled egg.

dishes.name: Ensalada de arroz y lentejas con aguacate y tomate
dishes.method: Combine cooked rice and lentils with diced avocado and tomato and dress with lemon.

dishes.name: Dal tadka (spiced red lentils)
dishes.method: Boil lentils with onion, tomato and spices, then pour a sizzling garlic and spice oil over the top.

dishes.name: Potaje de garbanzos majao
dishes.method: Cook chickpeas in a base of tomato, onion and pepper and finish with a cumin and garlic paste.

dishes.name: Sweet potato, chickpea and spinach curry
dishes.method: Simmer sweet potato in a spiced tomato sauce, then add chickpeas and spinach until wilted.

dishes.name: Mediterranean chickpea salad
dishes.method: Toss chickpeas with diced cucumber, tomato, onion and feta in a lemon dressing.

dishes.name: Merluza al horno con patatas panaderas
dishes.method: Roast thin slices of potato and onion in one tray, then lay the hake on top and bake until it flakes.

dishes.name: Chicken saag (mild chicken and spinach curry)
dishes.method: Simmer chicken in a mildly spiced onion and tomato sauce with plenty of wilted spinach, and stir in yogurt at the end.

dishes.name: Creamy Greek yogurt chicken pasta
dishes.method: Toss whole wheat pasta with sliced cooked chicken and spinach in a sauce of yogurt, a little cheese, lemon and pasta water, off the heat.
